turns.q: Can I reroute the package to a different address?
turns.replyTail:
now!
Can I reroute the package to a different address?
I found that orders cannot be canceled or changed once placed. Because of this policy, rerouting to a different address isn’t available through Happy Wax after your order has been placed.
If your package has already shipped, your tracking email might show any carrier options available for that shipment. However, I can’t confirm carrier rerouting based on Happy Wax’s policy.
If you have any other questions or need more help, just let me know!
